name: Hibiku Oni Hime ~Okoreru Ushi Oni~
source:
This is a prologue story to "Bloodlust Demon Princess". 
This time the story focuses on the heroines' activities instead of corruption. 
Please enjoy the world of "Hibiki-tan"!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE243664.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是《嗜血魔公主》的序幕故事。
这次的故事重点是女主角的活动而不是腐败。
请尽情享受“响炭”的世界吧！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE243664.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
